blocks.text: The Microsoft Surface Go 2 2-in-1 Tablet with Keyboard is designed for users who need flexible productivity in a lightweight, portable form. Switch effortlessly between tablet mode and laptop mode by attaching or detaching the keyboard—ideal for light office work, study, and everyday tasks.Powered by an Intel Core m3-8100Y processor, this Surface Go 2 delivers smooth and reliable performance for email, document editing, web browsing, video conferencing, and online learning. It’s a smart choice for professionals and students who want mobility without sacrificing usability.With 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD, the system starts quickly, responds smoothly, and provides dependable storage for work files, presentations, and school projects. The 10.5-inch Full HD (1920 × 1280) touchscreen offers clear visuals and responsive touch control, making note-taking, browsing, and media consumption comfortable and intuitive.Running Windows 11 Pro, the Surface Go 2 supports business-grade security, multitasking tools, and compatibility with professional and educational software—making it a versatile solution for modern, on-the-go productivity.

items.label: 2-in-1 Design with Keyboard
items.value: Use it as a tablet or a laptop—detach or attach the keyboard to switch instantly between touch mode and typing mode, perfect for flexible work and study needs.

items.label: Faster Performance with Intel Core m3 Processor
items.value: Powered by Intel Core m3-8100Y processor, delivering smoother performance than standard entry-level models—perfect for multitasking, video calls, and daily office tasks.

items.label: 8GB RAM + 128GB SSD for Smooth Operation
items.value: 8GB RAM ensures responsive performance, while the 128GB SSD provides fast boot times, quick file access, and reliable storage for documents and media.

items.label: 10.5” Full HD Touchscreen Display
items.value: 10.5-inch FHD (1920×1280) touchscreen offers sharp visuals, accurate colors, and intuitive touch control for note-taking, browsing, and streaming.

items.label: Windows 11 Pro Advantage
items.value: Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, offering advanced security, intuitive tools, and a professional environment designed for both work and personal use.
